spec_match.rationale: Accurately documents the directive merger for Isolated Web Apps and correctly scopes it to IWAs, not standard pages.

interactive.rationale: Zero buttons, selects, or inputs — this is a static prose/code guide, which rule 7 forbids as a concept page.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Page delivers exactly the header-migration walkthrough its title and lede promise.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers the IWA-only scope caveat in prose but offers no interactive exploration of failure or mixed-header cases.

conformance.rationale: Injected feature-level suite renders honestly at 4 pass / 2 fail in this Chromium 141 session.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless CDP 2026-08-16: page renders fully, zero console errors, zero failed requests.

telemetry_health.rationale: Only injected page-level telemetry.js; no per-demo interaction or assert telemetry.

design_system.rationale: Uses shared CSS variables throughout with no raw hex.

accessibility.rationale: Static semantic prose is readable, but there are no controls and no live regions to evaluate; heading/link structure is sound.

openQuestions.title: Make the migration guide interactive
openQuestions.detail: The page is a pure static guide with no controls — rule 7 requires a hands-on surface. A before/after header transformer (paste a pre-151 Permissions-Policy header, get the merged local-network/loopback-network equivalent with a diff) would fit the existing content, mirroring the policy-demo page's detection pattern.

guidanceConsulted.query: review pass: accessible live output, honest capability fallbacks, keyboard operability for existing concept demo
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Verify semantic controls, live-region announcements for async state, visible focus, and honest unsupported states rather than fake success.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Review-only critique (no frontend change shipped with it): the rubric applied this guidance as the review bar; the page itself was not modified.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Headless-Chrome CDP drive of the page's controls on 2026-08-16 with console/network capture.

summary: Driven headless 2026-08-16: page loads cleanly with zero console errors and the feature conformance panel honestly reports 4 pass / 2 fail, but there is nothing to interact with — no buttons, inputs, or selects were found, making this a static code-card page.
